entries.verified: CTO-46 §1.4, doc 2026-11-14: Settings > Computer > Your computer > «Execution on this computer» is «Ask every time» by default, one per computer; the other values are «Always allow» and «Never allow». The page does not describe how the value is stored (security): it is declared by the person (BV-248, CTO-56 §2.2 B1)

CTO-46 §1.4, doc 2026-11-14: «Recommend Never allow unless a Bot has a specific reason to work on local files»; «Always allow» is not covered by Auto-review: «Auto Review governs only work inside the hosted computer»

CTO-46 §1.4, doc 2026-11-14: Settings > General > Bot > Auto-review is on by default and governs only the cloud computer; «Bot work runs on the cloud computer» (faq). Kept in the account: declared (B2)

CTO-46 §1.4, doc 2026-11-14: «Ask first» and «Allow automatically» rules are written by the person in natural language, 20 of each, «Ask first» wins, «saved to your account, so they apply from every desktop»; none by default. Declared (B3)
CTO-46 §1.4, doc 2026-11-14: connectors (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Slack…) are turned on per tool in «Connect apps», none by default; their tokens stay «on Cursor's connector backend». Declared (B4)
